description: The RUN_ERROR codes Node ends a run with when a dependency is degraded (QA-17, C-1): the web app words each in the reader's language (frontend harness-errors.ts runErrorText, every locale) instead of showing Node's English message. A failure the worker answers (a model call the port classified) ends RUN_FINISHED with its error answer, not here. The degraded-dependency fault suite fails on a RUN_ERROR whose code is not listed.
